original_reply:
Hi Siyu, Aleksandr,

Thank you both. -02 takes up your suggestions:

  *
Entity Type is now conditional: needed when the client has to tell
     *
kinds of AI resource apart to choose its next step, and usually
implied by the carrier, such as a well-known name, or by the
Endpoint purpose (Sections 7 and 8.2).
  *
A protocols value can name a version of the agent protocol; where
     *
it does not, the binding states how the client learns which version
to use (Sections 8.2 and 9).
  *
Next to Freshness: a version need not change when a description
     *
changes, while the digest of a description Endpoint does
(Section 8.2).

Aleksandr, the mapping to draft-artamokhov-dawn-marketplace-discovery
is a useful check that the elements fit a deployed discovery document.

-02: https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-cui-dawn-mdi-model/

Best,
Chenguang
scope: Literal passage presence comparison in the two saved published drafts; original reply separated from quoted owner messages. Individual Internet-Draft, not an adopted standard.
